description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeavePeriodDao class in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It contains multiple tests verifying the functionality of saving leave period history, retrieving current leave periods, and handling entitlement updates when leave periods change.

classes.name: LeavePeriodDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the LeavePeriodDao's functionalities, including saving leave period history, retrieving current periods, and updating entitlements upon leave period change.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and loads fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistoryFirstTime
methods.description: Tests saving leave period history when no current leave period exists.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistory
methods.description: Tests saving leave period history when a current leave period exists, ensuring entitlement strategies are invoked correctly.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistoryWithTransactionException
methods.description: Verifies rollback behavior and exception handling when a transaction error occurs during saving.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the current leave period start date and month.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Validates retrieval of the leave period history list, ensuring correct historical data is returned.

methods.name: testEntitlementChangeWhenLeavePeriodChanged
methods.description: Tests adjusting leave entitlements correctly when the leave period configuration changes.
